headline: Nevish Line Swings Colonial; Weathered Expanse Fights Itself to Ruin
war_summary: Since our last edition the Nevish Line has swung toward the Colonial flag, six stands to two Warden, where only hours before the count stood even, and its dead still mount among the fastest of any front. The Weathered Expanse, lately tilted Colonial, has fought back to an even two-two split with five of its nine bases razed; it remains the busiest ground in the war at fifty-seven flag events in a day, Wightwalk the most-contested post. Linn Mercy keeps its eight-two Colonial majority but shows one base now rubble, fighting about Lathair and Outwich Ranch pushing losses past five thousand Colonial and eight thousand Warden in twenty-four hours. Mooring County's storm at The Wind Hills still fills casualty rolls, Colonial losses outpacing Warden, though its flags have stilled these past hours. Stonecradle shows fresh flag movement near World's End and The Reach, while Marban Hollow posts no new flags since early morning even as its casualty count climbs. Callahans Passage quickens again after its lull, and the Dead Lands cool. It is day 748; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
